'''John Woollen''' of Terre Haute, Indiana finished 15th of 49 at the [[1999 Corellia Regionals]] in Indianapolis with 8 (+17).<ref name="cec-reg">[http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/regional.html 1999 Corellia Regional Championship], Alex Alcalde, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000618013958/http://www.geocities.com:80/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/regional.html Internet Archive]</ref> He lost to [[Jared Lockwood]] in the third game with Hunt Down and Destroy the Jedi.
